question: Owner request 2026-11-16 (per-machine usage to a central location; headroom without hurting existing throughput): which of three rival tools (A machine-load, B host-headroom-20261116, C tools/host-headroom) is the fleet's one tool, and what survives from the others?

guard.reason: proposer owns no candidate here; guard not applicable.

rows.statement: Excludes owner quiet windows read in the REAL FleetQuiet record format (windows\<id>.json, armedUtc/untilUtc; .released history).
rows.incident: coretemp-fleet RESULTS.md 2026-11-15: thermal trials run all-core saturation at the 74 W cap inside FleetQuiet windows, and the unquiet 050413Z-stacked run was contaminated by background work; counting a trial as project load reads a mini as FULL and teaches a false slowdown curve.

A.evidence:
real record fields: id,host,armedUtc,untilUtc,reason,directive,source,before,adapters,deadman
REAL_FORMAT_EXCLUDED=False
CONTROL (fields startUtc/endUtc +-24 h, which FleetQuiet never writes) excluded=True
CONTROL (startUtc/endUtc +-1 h) excluded=False

real record fields: id,host,armedUtc,untilUtc,reason,directive,source,before,adapters,deadman
REAL_FORMAT_EXCLUDED=False (B has no quiet-window reader: 0 files reference FleetQuiet)

rows.statement: Answers the throughput question: at the SAME utilisation, a measured slowdown of running work turns ROOM into TIGHT/FULL.
rows.incident: Owner request 2026-11-16 ("without negatively impacting throughput"); RESULTS.md: all minis hold the ~74 W cap, so power not cores sets speed, and one trial did 21 % less work at the same 74 W; utilisation alone cannot see it.

A.evidence: VERDICT_FLAT=ROOM VERDICT_SLOW=FULL safe_slow=8 basis_slow=clock falls below 90 % of its light-load value from 8 busy threads (measured)

rows.statement: An idle-CPU machine whose HeavySlot gate is held 70 % of the time with 20-min waits is not reported as plain ROOM (verdict or a surfaced gate verdict says so).
rows.incident: Measured 2026-11-16 on PC-MINI3: CPU p95 ~28 % while HeavySlot jobs waited up to 43 min (slot held 70 % of the day); a new heavy project queues behind every incumbent whatever the CPU says.

rows.statement: Reading the HeavySlot ledger never makes HeavySlot's own append (AppendData, FileShare ReadWrite|Delete) fail. Negative control: a FileShare.Read holder must block it.
rows.incident: heavy-slot.ps1 Add-LedgerLine swallows a failed append as a WARN, so a reader holding FileShare.Read silently drops admit/exit lines (and so corrupts every duty/wait figure); TRAPS 2026-08-08: a locked file blocked the next build.

rows.incident: heartbeats/README.md: a board that never installed the duty and one whose task stopped both look like a quiet board; RULINGS 2026-08-30 test 4: silence has been read as health too many times on this bus.

rows.incident: Bus README law 4 and CI-COST-CONTROL.md: the bus is public by owner decision; heartbeats/README warns literal paths are machine facts with an expiry date.
